014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.util.Collection;
017import java.util.List;
018import java.util.Map;
019import java.util.Objects;
020
021import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
022
023import java.util.function.BiFunction;
024
025public interface Selectable<C, T> {
026
027  // Filters this thing according to the supplied criteria, producing a List.
028  // List not Stream to permit caching
029  // List not Collection so equals() is well-defined
030  // List is unmodifiable and is always valid for the supplied criteria (unenforceable)
031  // C and not Predicate because equality semantics for Predicate are not well-defined (caching again)
032  public List<T> select(final C criteria);
033
034  public default List<T> list() {
035    return this.select(null);
036  }
037
038  /*
039   * Static methods.
040   */
041
042
043  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
044  public static <C, E> Selectable<C, E> of(final Collection<? extends E> collection, final BiFunction<? super E, ? super C, ? extends Boolean> f) {
045    Objects.requireNonNull(f, "f");
046    return collection.isEmpty() ? c -> List.of() : c -> (List<E>)collection.stream()
047      .filter(e -> f.apply(e, c))
048      .toList();
049  }
050
051  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
052  public static <C, E> Selectable<C, E> ofCaching(final Collection<? extends E> collection, final BiFunction<? super E, ? super C, ? extends Boolean> f) {
053    Objects.requireNonNull(f, "f");
054    if (collection.isEmpty()) {
055      return c -> List.of();
056    }
057    final Map<C, List<? extends E>> m = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
058    return c ->
059      (List<E>)m.computeIfAbsent(c, fc -> collection.stream()
060                                 .filter(e -> f.apply(e, fc))
061                                 .toList());
062  }
063
064}
